ztb.trading.live.action_mask_provider module

Action Mask Provider for Live Trading

Provides action masking functionality for MaskablePPO models in live trading without requiring a full gym environment instance.

This module addresses Bug #27 by allowing proper action masking in production.

class ztb.trading.live.action_mask_provider.ActionMaskConfig(min_holding_period: int = 5, enable_forced_close: bool = True, max_position_age: int = 1000)[source]

Bases: object

Configuration for action masking in live trading.

min_holding_period: int = 5

Minimum time steps to hold a position before allowing closure.

enable_forced_close: bool = True

Enable forced position close on take-profit/stop-loss.

max_position_age: int = 1000

Maximum age of position before forcing closure.

class ztb.trading.live.action_mask_provider.ActionMaskProvider(config: ActionMaskConfig)[source]

Bases: object

Lightweight action mask provider for MaskablePPO in live trading.

This class provides the same action masking logic as the gym environment but without requiring a full environment instance.

Bug #27 Fix: Enables proper MaskablePPO usage in live trading with action masking safety features (min_holding_period, forced closes, etc.)

update_state(current_position: float, position_entry_step: int, current_step: int, forced_close_reason: str | None = None) → None[source]

Update internal state for mask calculation.

Parameters:

  • current_position – Current position size (positive=long, negative=short, 0=flat)

  • position_entry_step – Step when current position was opened

  • current_step – Current time step

  • forced_close_reason – Reason for forced close (take-profit/stop-loss) or None

get_action_mask() → ndarray[Any, dtype[bool_]][source]

Get valid action mask based on current state.

Returns:

Boolean array [hold_valid, buy_valid, sell_valid]

Indices correspond to ACTION_HOLD=0, ACTION_BUY=1, ACTION_SELL=2

Return type:

NDArray[np.bool_]

Mask Logic: - Forced close: Only allow closing action - Min holding period: Block closing if position too young - Max position age: Force close if position too old - Default: Allow all actions compatible with current position

get_action_masks() → ndarray[Any, dtype[bool_]][source]

Alias for get_action_mask() for compatibility with predict_with_masks.

get_mask_info() → Dict[str, Any][source]

Get detailed information about current masking state.

Returns:

Dict with mask state, position info, and reasoning

ztb.trading.live.order_state module

Order state machine and idempotency management.

This module provides state management for trading orders with idempotency guarantees to prevent duplicate orders and ensure reliable execution.
